title: Turkish Pear Pide
description: A traditional Turkish flatbread topped with sweet pear and a hint of spice. Perfect as a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: Turkish Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Roll out the pide dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the softened butter evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the butter with sliced pear, leaving a small border around the edges.
Sprinkle the Turkish spice blend over the pear.
Drizzle honey over the pear and spice blend.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the pear is tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
